selection.ownership: Cockroach Labs, Inc., New York, NY, United States. International CockroachDB Cloud API at cockroachlabs.cloud.

research.searchCoverage: Official CockroachDB Cloud API v1 (Bearer secret key, Cc-Version 2024-09-16, GET /api/v1/organization, /clusters, /clusters/{id}, /clusters/available-regions), Cockroach Labs Inc. New York identity, and dated incident search reviewed on 2026-09-13. Historical advisories A-133479 (OIDC credentials in diagnostics, 2024-10-25) and S-26052016 (privilege escalation patched May 2026) are recorded; neither is a current unresolved Cloud API customer-data compromise. Not a breach-free claim.

Official CockroachDB Cloud API uses Authorization Bearer and recommended Cc-Version 2024-09-16 on https://cockroachlabs.cloud. GET /api/v1/organization is OrganizationsApi.GetOrganizationInfo and the pinned credential validator. GET /api/v1/clusters, /clusters/{cluster_id}, and /clusters/available-regions are documented reads. Operator is Cockroach Labs, Inc., New York. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found historical product advisories, not a current unresolved Cloud API compromise.

incidents.finding: Advisory A-133479: diagnostics reporting, if enabled, may have sent OIDC credentials stored in cluster settings to a limited-access Cockroach Labs telemetry database. Historical; not a current unresolved Cloud API compromise.
incidents.limitation: Coverage is dated 2026-09-13 and is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.finding: Advisory S-26052016: two privilege-escalation issues in CockroachDB versions before the listed patches. Product CVE with published remediation, not an unresolved Cloud API customer-data breach.
incidents.limitation: Patched-version guidance is from the public advisory; live clusters were not verified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.
